items.review_rationale: Read constructibility as a finite union of open differences U\V with each open retrocompact in ambient X; distinguished retrocompact openness from arbitrary quasicompactness.

references.phrase: retrocompact open subset U of X
references.context: Open U whose intersections with every quasi-compact open subset of X are quasi-compact; not assumed equivalent to U itself quasi-compact in all spaces.

references.phrase: difference U\V of retrocompact open sets
references.context: Set of points in open U not belonging to open V, for U and V satisfying retrocompactness.

references.phrase: finite union of locally closed-type pieces
references.context: Finite set union over differences U_i\V_i under the stated retrocompact-open conditions.

references.disposition: The source-specific retrocompact-open definition should not be replaced by every locally closed subset in an arbitrary topological space.

items.review_rationale: Read locally constructible E in X by an open cover and constructibility of each restriction E∩V_i inside the subspace V_i, not necessarily global finite constructibility.

references.phrase: constructible subset in the source convention

references.context: Family of open subsets whose union is X, possibly infinite.
Intersection of E with each cover set, tested as a subset of the subspace V_i with its own topology.

references.disposition: The locally constructible condition needs a suitable covering, not the statement that E is globally constructible.
